measurement_rules.estimated: arithmetic on a format, standing in for a copy nothing counted
measurement_rules.logical: the size of a buffer a stage was handed, or wrote; not a bus transfer
measurement_rules.measured: a counter, or the return value of the read or write that did the moving, from the run itself
measurement_rules.not_reached: the branch did not run in this configuration
measurement_rules.unavailable: nothing observes this, and no number - including 0 - is claimed

rows.allocation_owner: pipeline._read_exactly allocates a bytearray per read
rows.name: decoder_rawvideo
rows.note: A pipe is a host byte stream: it cannot carry a device pointer or a GPU resource handle, so whatever the decoder did on the GPU, the frame arrives here as bytes.

rows.name: decoder_gpu_to_cpu_download
rows.note: FFmpeg exposes no transfer counter, so this row's payload is the size of the copy that must have happened, not a measured figure.

rows.allocation_owner: cv2 allocates the destination per call
rows.consumer: working-colour prepare and the residual composite
rows.name: source_full_bgr
rows.note: The 4K frame the residual adds its detail back to.

rows.consumer: the RGBA conversion below, and the residual's low-resolution term
rows.name: working_bgr
rows.note: Written by the native bridge's Lanczos pass.

rows.name: working_rgba_for_dlss
rows.note: The buffer the DLSS host is handed exists in both orders and is written once per frame in both. Counted at the conversion seam, at this site only: the total a frame makes across both sites is a different number and is not what this row claims. The bytes are the buffer this conversion wrote, which is its payload, not a bus transfer.

rows.name: working_rgba_for_nvof
rows.note: A second, separate RGBA copy of the same working frame: the flow engine converts for itself rather than consuming the buffer above. A temporal hint reset makes it convert the reference frame too, which is why the steady-state median is the number that matters.

rows.allocation_owner: nvof_bridge session input surface (allocated once per session)
rows.name: nvof_input_upload
rows.note: Native counter. Steady state uploads once; a temporal-hint reset uploads the current and the reference frame. Four bytes per pixel, because the bridge of this era takes RGBA; the reduced order uploads the same frame as BGR24.

rows.name: nvof_flow_download
rows.note: Native counter. The flow reaches DLSS as a host pointer, so this copy is on the path in every mode.

rows.name: depth_plane
rows.note: A zero plane when no depth source is configured; the write still happens.

rows.name: dlss_colour_input
rows.note: What the wrapper does with the pointer is not observable from the public ABI; this is the size of what it was handed.

rows.name: dlss_internal_gpu_io
rows.note: No public export reports a transfer and no host source exists here, so no number - including zero - belongs in this row.

rows.name: dlss_output_bgr
rows.note: The second tracked conversion: it exists only to hand the residual a BGR-ordered buffer, because the residual reads BGR channels.

rows.name: recon_full_bgr
rows.producer: residual backend reconstruct (signed residual + Catmull-Rom + composite)

rows.name: output_resize
rows.note: The target equals the source in this configuration, so the pipeline aliases the reconstruction buffer and no resize runs.

rows.allocation_owner: written straight out of the buffer above
rows.name: encoder_rawvideo
rows.note: The write call's own return value, summed per frame - not a width times a height times three.

rows.name: encoder_gpu_upload
rows.note: FFmpeg uploads what it reads and reports nothing about it; the pipe row above is the measured part.
rows.producer: ffmpeg's own upload of the rawvideo it read

transfer_mode_meaning.legacy: the working plane is converted to RGBA for the DLSS host, NVOF is handed a second CPU-reordered copy of it, and the host's RGBA output is converted back to BGR before the residual composite reads it
transfer_mode_meaning.reduced: one filter pass writes both the BGR plane and the RGBA plane, the BGR plane goes to the NVOF bridge as it stands and is reordered on the GPU, and the residual composite reads the host's RGBA output where the host wrote it

cpu_bgr_to_rgba@dlss_input_calls.source: cpu_bgr_to_rgba calls made by the dlss_input conversion site of the production path, incremented at that site

cpu_bgr_to_rgba@dlss_input_output_bytes.source: bytes of the buffer the dlss_input cpu_bgr_to_rgba conversion wrote

cpu_bgr_to_rgba@nvof_input_calls.source: cpu_bgr_to_rgba calls made by the nvof_input conversion site of the production path, incremented at that site

cpu_bgr_to_rgba@nvof_input_output_bytes.source: bytes of the buffer the nvof_input cpu_bgr_to_rgba conversion wrote

cpu_bgr_to_rgba_calls.source: incremented at the convert_color() call site that does the work

cpu_color_conversion_output_bytes.source: output buffer size of each tracked channel-order conversion

cpu_rgba_to_bgr@residual_input_calls.source: cpu_rgba_to_bgr calls made by the residual_input conversion site of the production path, incremented at that site

cpu_rgba_to_bgr@residual_input_output_by.source: bytes of the buffer the residual_input cpu_rgba_to_bgr conversion wrote

cpu_rgba_to_bgr_calls.source: incremented at the convert_color() call site that does the work

decoder_gpu_to_cpu_bytes_estimated.source: NV12 payload the hwdownload filter writes when CUDA decode runs; FFmpeg exposes no transfer counter, so this is arithmetic on the frame format, not a measurement

decoder_pipe_bytes.source: bytes read out of the decoder child process' stdout, summed from the reads that produced the frame

dlss_gpu_transfer_bytes_measured.source: the public dlssnr_host ABI reports no transfer counter and its source is not in the repository; there is no number here, and the buffer sizes above are not one

dlss_input_color_bytes_logical.source: size of the host buffer passed as the DLSS colour input; the host wrapper's internal transfers are not observable

dlss_input_depth_bytes_logical.source: size of the host buffer passed as the DLSS depth input

dlss_input_flow_bytes_logical.source: size of the host buffer passed as the DLSS motion input

dlss_output_bytes_logical.source: size of the host buffer the DLSS output was written into

encoder_gpu_upload_bytes_measured.source: FFmpeg uploads the rawvideo it reads, and exposes no counter for that copy

encoder_pipe_bytes.source: bytes returned by the write into the encoder child process' stdin

nvof_d2h_bytes_measured.source: nvof_bridge_get_counters, read either side of the frame

nvof_d2h_copy_count.source: nvof_bridge_get_counters, read either side of the frame

nvof_h2d_bytes_measured.source: nvof_bridge_get_counters, read either side of the frame

nvof_h2d_copy_count.source: nvof_bridge_get_counters, read either side of the frame

nvof_input_format.source: the format the flow engine says it handed to the NVOF bridge
